AN UNEXPECTED GUEST

Sterling AG | Clash of Clans

Games

2021 is the first year that the agency that represents the popular mobile video game “Clash of Clans” of the Indian region makes an animated video to celebrate the Diwali holidays. “An Unexpected Guest” is an amazing opportunity for DeeDee’s artists to show our ability in every animation frame. DeeDee landed on something we think is unique. From the character designs to the backgrounds, everything is a combination of humor, cuteness, and horror. The funny and weird movements make the audience curious about what happens next.


According to Adgully statistics, “An Unexpected Guest” has reached 123 million impressions within 24 hours released on social media.

2021 is the first year that the agency that represents the popular mobile video game “Clash of Clans” of the Indian region makes an animated video to celebrate the Diwali holidays. “An Unexpected Guest” is an amazing opportunity for DeeDee’s artists to show our ability in every animation frame. DeeDee landed on something we think is unique. From the character designs to the backgrounds, everything is a combination of humor, cuteness, and horror. The funny and weird movements make the audience curious about what happens next.

According to Adgully statistics, “An Unexpected Guest” has reached 123 million impressions within 24 hours released on social media.
